Class LibraryTopBarBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.presentation.libraryViews.LibraryTopBarBuilder
public class LibraryTopBarBuilder extends Object
Builds the top bar for the My Library page.

Pure UI construction: takes already-resolved data (availableGenres) and callbacks via LibraryTopBarBuilder.Config, and has no dependency on any repository or service. Callers are responsible for fetching genres and wiring the returned LibraryTopBarBuilder.Result.tabButtons() into their own state.

SRP: Only responsible for constructing the top bar node.
